{{recipesummary|category=Dessert sauce recipes| Yield = 1 ½ cups|time=6 minutes|difficulty=2}}
{{recipe}}

This recipe makes a vegan approximation of a caramel sauce without caramelizing sugar.

==Ingredients==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (480 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
*¾ cup [[Cookbook:Vegan_cuisine#Milks (Nut, Grain and Legume Liquids)|soy milk, rice milk, or other non-dairy milk]] of choice
*¾ cup [[Cookbook:Turbinado Sugar|turbinado sugar]]
*⅓ cup [[Cookbook:Maple Syrup|maple syrup]] or [[Cookbook:Brown Rice Syrup|brown rice syrup]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
*1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Arrowroot|arrowroot]] starch
*2 tbsp vegan [[Cookbook:Margarine|margarine]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]]

==Procedure==

# In a small [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]], combine the soy milk, turbinado sugar, and maple syrup. [[Cookbook:Whisk|Whisk]] well to combine.
# Cook over medium heat, while whisking occasionally, for 3 minutes.
# In a small bowl, whisk together the water and arrowroot, and then whisk this mixture into the saucepan.
# Cook the mixture, while whisking constantly, an additional 2–3 minutes or until it thickens.
# Remove the saucepan from the heat and whisk in the remaining ingredients.
# Serve, or store in an airtight container in the refrigerator and reheat as needed.
